headline: Brown & Brown (BRO) Stock May Be 28% Undervalued On Excess Returns
summary: Brown & Brown has seen its share price move around over the past year, and the question now is whether the current US$69.40 level lines up with the returns the insurer earns on the capital it puts to work. For anyone tracking the stock, the key issue is how that price squares with the profitability of the business model rather than just the recent trading pattern.
